official_sources.title: Restore to a new project
official_sources.finding: Restoration creates an independent project with mirrored compute and disk attributes; Supabase displays and charges additional monthly project costs.

official_sources.title: Manage Compute usage
official_sources.finding: Every launched project adds dedicated compute usage and increases monthly compute costs.

official_sources.title: Pricing
official_sources.finding: Paid-plan additional projects start from 10 USD per month before any extra disk or add-on usage.

official_sources.title: Database Backups
official_sources.finding: Restoring a backup in place makes the source project inaccessible during restoration and changes the live database.

decision.reason: A separate recovery copy would add project charges; an in-place restore would modify and interrupt production. Neither is allowed under the current user constraint.
decision.safe_alternative_completed: Read-only live schema contract plus 758-row synthetic full-chain and PostgreSQL lock/rollback rehearsal.
